questions.question: What is the primary characteristic of Redis as a data store?

options.A: It is a disk-based relational database
options.B: It is an open-source, in-memory data structure store used as a database, cache, and message broker

questions.question: Which command is used to set a value for a specific key in Redis?

options.B: SET

questions.question: What is the time complexity of the GET and SET commands for a single key?

options.B: O(n)

questions.question: Which Redis data type is most suitable for storing a unique collection of unordered strings?

options.B: Set

questions.question: What is a Redis 'Hash' most similar to in other programming languages?

questions.question: Which command allows you to set a key with an expiration time in seconds?

options.B: TTL

options.B: 512 MB

options.B: Bitmap

questions.question: What is 'HyperLogLog' used for in Redis?

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a valid Redis data structure?

options.B: Geospatial Index

options.B: RDB (Redis Database Backup)

questions.question: What is the advantage of 'AOF' over 'RDB'?

questions.question: Which command is used to start a transaction in Redis?

questions.question: How do you execute all commands queued in a Redis transaction?

questions.question: Which command is used to get the length of a Redis List?

options.B: GEOADD

questions.question: Which command would you use to find the distance between two geospatial members in Redis?

options.B: GEOMAP

questions.question: What is a 'Redis Stream'?

options.B: NAME

questions.question: What is 'LFU' eviction policy?

options.B: Least Frequently Used

questions.question: What is the default port for a Redis server?
Which command provides information and statistics about the Redis server?

questions.question: Which command is used to find keys matching a specific pattern?

options.B: Operations that are guaranteed to complete without interference from other clients

options.B: CRC16(key) modulo 16384

options.B: A feature where Redis tracks keys the client has cached locally and sends an invalidation message when they change

questions.question: Which command would you use to find the object type of a key (e.g., zipmap, linkedlist, hashtable)?

options.B: OBJECT ENCODING

questions.question: What is 'Gossip Protocol' in Redis Cluster?

questions.question: Which command is used to monitor all requests processed by the Redis server in real-time?

options.B: MONITOR

questions.question: What is the 'Slow Log'?

options.A: A log of users who type slowly

options.B: XGET

questions.question: What is 'Redis Bitfield' used for?

options.B: Manipulating arbitrary-sized integers at specific bit offsets within a string key

questions.question: What is 'Redis ACL' (Access Control List)?

options.B: A security feature that allows defining permissions for specific users and commands

questions.question: Which command is used to manage ACL users?

options.B: ACL SETUSER

options.A: Replication that happens once a day

options.A: Deleting keys that are too large

options.B: MEMORY USAGE <key>

options.B: A probabilistic data structure used to check if an element is a member of a set with no false negatives

options.B: A distributed lock manager algorithm proposed for Redis to handle multi-master lock acquisition safely

questions.question: What is 'Redis Latency Monitor'?

options.A: A tool to measure internet speed
options.B: A feature to identify and troubleshoot latency spikes by recording operations that take too long

questions.question: What is 'Active Defragmentation'?

options.A: Moving the server to a new location

options.B: A module that allows storing, updating, and querying JSON documents as a first-class data type

options.B: A powerful indexing and full-text search engine for data stored in Redis

questions.question: What is 'Redis-benchmark' tool?

options.B: A utility used to simulate concurrent clients and measure the performance of a Redis server

options.A: To change the name of a key

questions.question: What is 'Redis Sentinel' failover timeout?

options.A: How long a user can be logged in
options.B: The time Sentinel waits after a Master is down before starting the election of a new Master

questions.question: What is 'Cluster Nodes' command output?

options.B: A detailed list of all nodes in the cluster, their roles, and the hash slots they manage

questions.question: What is 'Redis Key TTL' precision?

options.B: Milliseconds

questions.question: Which command is used to set a millisecond-precision timeout for a key?

options.B: PEXPIRE

questions.question: Final Expert Question: In a Redis Cluster, what is the 'Epoch' used for?

options.B: A versioning mechanism to ensure all nodes agree on the cluster configuration and Master promotions
